title: Janus Engine R2A — self-drive and net-generation gate
design_transition: Move from SELF_SERVICE, where internal streams perform multiple useful duties, to SELF_DRIVE, where the central energy-conversion core pays the auxiliary power bill, and finally to NET_GENERATION, where useful power remains after every internal load is counted.
energy_source_boundary: No energy is created by oxygen extraction, nitrogen recycling, heat recuperation or closed mass loops. The central core requires a real external energy source such as stored chemical fuel, electrochemical reactants, an external thermal gradient or another explicitly modeled source. Oxygen is an oxidizer, not a fuel.

states.SELF_SERVICE: Process streams such as N2, recovered water and thermal gradients are cascaded through multiple useful duties before recycle or discharge.
states.SELF_DRIVE: The central core supplies enough shaft/electrical power to run gill rotation, water circulation or hydrodynamic losses, gas separation, drying, sorbent regeneration, compression, refrigeration, pumps, valves and control electronics.
states.NET_GENERATION: After all auxiliary loads are paid, positive power remains for storage, propulsion or an external electrical/mechanical load.

shaft_architecture.concept: A central common mechanical/electrical bus replaces the permanent external drive motor during steady operation.
candidate_loads: working-fluid and water pumps where required
control and valve power through a DC bus
shaft_architecture.starter_generator_mode: A motor-generator may start the system from stored electrical energy; once the core is stable the power direction reverses and the same bus charges storage and supports auxiliaries.
shaft_architecture.steady_state_rule: Starter energy is not counted as proof of autonomy; only sustained post-start steady-state balances may pass R2A.

governing_equations.auxiliary_power: P_aux = P_gills + P_water_hydraulic + P_separation + P_drying + P_compression + P_refrigeration + P_sorbent + P_pumps + P_controls + P_losses
governing_equations.pass_condition: P_core_shaft > P_aux for a sustained defined operating point with all mass and heat balances closed

system_invariants: WATER_FLOW_PRESSURE_DROP_IS_AN ENERGY COST EVEN WHEN CREATED BY VEHICLE MOTION
recommended_start_sequence: STARTER: battery / external motor spins pumps, gill rotor and control system
PRIME: establish water flow, dissolved-gas extraction and safe gas conditioning
CORE_LIGHT: enable the selected non-cryogenic energy-conversion core at low load
LOAD_TRANSFER: progressively transfer gill, pump, separation and control loads from starter supply to core bus
SELF_DRIVE_GATE: disconnect external steady-state drive and verify P_net_shaft > 0
GENERATION_GATE: connect generator load only from measured surplus
CRYOGENIC_OPTION: add LOX branch only after gaseous-O2 self-drive has positive margin
validation_boundary: This record defines a first-principles gate, not a claim that a working autonomous engine exists. Numerical simulations must mark assumed parameters separately from measured parameters.
